verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an official MCP server, so AI agents can query and act on Datadog through natural-language prompts. It also has a Bits AI docs page and a ChatGPT plugin for analyzing Experiments. However, the pack only gives titles for these, with no description of which operations can be driven by natural-language commands or how broadly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command coverage across the platform (e.g. creating monitors, querying logs or incidents via chat), Bits AI capability details, hands-on or independent corroboration.
